jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. This is a finished static runtime illustration for the SAME Chinese company year-of-the-sheep annual-party H5 game, not a new style proposal. Reference 1 is the locked character design: compact round cream-white plush sheep, large warm light-cream face, shiny black bean eyes, peach nose, warm tan curled horns, short brown hooves, red scarf, exactly one gold bell. Preserve that identity and soft tactile wool. Reference 2 is the existing visual target: warm polished soft-3D toy-farm rendering, honey wood, fresh green grass, cream and vermilion accents, soft upper-left daylight, consistent gentle shadows. Do not create a low-poly, flat-vector or long-bodied sheep. No watermark or UI controls. Asset: a wide landscape 2:1 HERO BANNER only, not a complete page. Reconstruct the upper hero portion of reference 2 as a coherent static illustration. On the LEFT, a large beautifully textured honey-brown wooden celebration sign with a vermilion rim, tiny leaves and restrained lantern decoration. The sign must read exactly the two-line fixed brand title '羊年' then '游园会' in large cream-gold softly raised Chinese characters. On the RIGHT, the complete front-three-quarter reference sheep smiling toward the viewer, with full horns, scarf, bell and hooves visible. Behind it is a coral-red farm barn, stacked hay and wooden fence. Foreground has gentle grass and a few small flowers. Rich scenery with readable depth, no clutter. Title and sheep are both primary, neither tiny. Keep the title inside the left 45%, sheep inside right 45%, keep all critical elements at least 6% from edges. Reserve a quiet thin band at the bottom for a separate DOM phase label; do not draw any status label, button, score, counter, QR, date or extra words. Fixed brand title is the ONLY text. This is one static branded banner, no grid, no panels.
